pages.text: $(t2)Tier 2$() raises the ceiling from 2x to $(bold)3x$() ore. The $(bold)Thermal Series$() Induction Smelter and Pulverizer are the mid-tier ore machines, and they make alloys like Invar and Electrum.$(br2)Tier 2 also brings real $(bold)power$(): a Stirling or Magmatic Dynamo feeds a Redstone Flux Cell, the grid every later tier draws on.

pages.title: Banking T2 Tokens
pages.text: Thermal machine blocks are the richest T2 submissions: an $(bold)Induction Smelter$() banks $(t2)50$() tokens, a $(bold)Pulverizer$() $(t2)40$(). Invar and Electrum mint per 50.$(br2)Bank $(t2){{tier 2 threshold}}$() in total to reach $(t3)Tier 3$(), where Mekanism unlocks. Full writeup: $(l:icraft:mods_t2/thermal)Thermal Series$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)Next: the Induction Smelter (50 tokens, and it smelts your Steel).$()
